Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have a diagnosis of cancer of any histologic type.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has a history of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and hypercholesterolemia, but no documented cancer diagnosis.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have a Karnofsky performance status great or equal to 70%.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No data provided regarding Karnofsky performance status.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have an expected survival for at least four months.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No explicit information about survival prognosis is provided.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Normal healthy volunteers to serve as control for this study.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has multiple comorbidities (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, hypercholesterolemia) disqualifying them as a healthy volunteer.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: All patients must sign informed consent approved by the Committee on the Use of Human Subjects at the University of Minnesota
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Females of child-bearing potential will be asked to take a pregnancy test before receiving vaccines.
Serious intercurrent medical illnesses which would interfere with the ability of the patient to carry out the follow-up monitoring program.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has severe cardiovascular disease, diabetes, hypercholesterolemia, and hepatic abnormalities that could interfere with monitoring.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Immunization should not be administered during the course of any febrile illness or acute infection.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of febrile illness or acute infection is mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Hypersensitivity to any component of the vaccine, including Thimerosal, a mercury derivative.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No history of hypersensitivity is documented.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: The occurrence of any type of neurologic symptoms to tetanus vaccine in the past.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has no history of tetanus vaccination or neurologic symptoms related to it.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with a history of seafood allergy are excluded from receiving KLH.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No seafood allergy history is mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Subjects who have had tetanus toxoid within the last 7 years are not eligible for tetanus vaccine component of this protocol.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No prior tetanus toxoid history is documented.

Recap: Patient does not meet cancer diagnosis requirement, lacks performance status data, and has multiple comorbidities disqualifying them as a healthy volunteer. Excluded due to serious intercurrent medical illnesses.
